verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say webhooks push real-time data when events happen in the account, and that webhook events can be used to monitor and handle transitions between subscription statuses. A Stripe PM also notes merchants can rely on their own webhooks instead of Stripe's customer emails, for example card-update notices. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of events for each named change (renewal, upgrade, payment failure, cancellation), documentation of delivery guarantees (retries, signature verification, idempotency), and independent hands-on corroboration of reliable delivery.
